title: Defensive attack-graph analysis (verifier-grounded)
purpose: hard, machine-checked security-analyst questions over formal AND/OR attack-graph models — shortest attack path, reachability under deployed defences, minimum defence cut, step enablement. Ground truth is the Z3 verifier / model semantics, so answers are objectively right or wrong and the tasks discriminate rather than everyone scoring 100%.
